skill.name: Ghost Hands
skill.description: Control your computers by voice: games and apps, volume, shutdown, web search.

port.label: Port for computers
port.description: The Ghost Hands client connects to NODUS on this port, 47300 by default. After a change, set the new port in the clients.

unknown_voice.label: When the voice is not recognized
unknown_voice.description: What to do when NODUS does not recognize the speaker by the voice profile.

voice_check.label: Voice check
voice_check.description: Confirm identity by repeating a phrase. Needs a voice profile.

children.label: Children
children.description: What users of the "child" type may do.
children.no_power: Everything except shutdown, restart and sleep

guests_shared.label: Guests control shared computers
guests_shared.description: In guest mode and for unknown voices.

ask_pc_every_time.label: Always ask which computer
ask_pc_every_time.description: Do not reuse the computer chosen in the last 2 minutes when several fit.

app_confidence.label: Name match to run without asking, %
app_confidence.description: Below this NODUS asks: "Launch Dota 2?". When several names are close, it asks which one. From 60 to 100, 86 by default. The computer app shows the match of a phrase: Apps and games → Check a phrase.

ai_names.label: Match names with AI
ai_names.description: When an app name is not recognized, the AI picks it from the list and NODUS asks to confirm. Only app names go to the AI.

reply_timeout.label: How long to wait for a computer, seconds

app_started.label: App or game started on a computer

app_stopped.label: App or game closed on a computer

parental_limit.label: Parental control: time on the computer or in games is over

parental_extended.label: Parental control: time extended with the button

parental_alert.label: Parental control: Ghost Hands was closed, the computer vanished or a PIN was entered

parental.killed: Ghost Hands on {{pc}} was force-closed and started again
parental.unclean_exit: Ghost Hands on {{pc}} was force-closed last time
parental.vanished: {{pc}} left the network without shutting down
parental.pin_failed: A wrong PIN was entered several times on {{pc}}
parental.pin_unlock: The limits on {{pc}} were lifted with the PIN

pc_run_app.label: Run on computer
pc_run_app.description: Starts an app or a game on the scenario owner's computer.
pc_run_app.keywords: computer pc run start game app

pc_power_action.label: Computer power
pc_power_action.description: Shuts down, restarts, puts to sleep or locks a computer.
pc_power_action.keywords: computer pc shutdown restart sleep lock

pc_set_volume.label: Computer volume
pc_set_volume.description: Changes the sound volume on a computer.

pc_show_message.label: Message on computer
pc_show_message.description: Shows a Windows notification on a computer.

pc_is_online.label: Computer online?
pc_is_online.description: Checks whether a computer is connected to NODUS.

pc_wake_up.label: Turn on computer
pc_wake_up.description: Wakes a computer over the network (Wake-on-LAN).
pc_wake_up.keywords: computer pc turn on wake wake on lan

common.not_ready: Ghost Hands is still starting. Try again in a minute.
common.no_pcs: You have no connected computers. The key to connect one is in the personal settings of the Ghost Hands skill.
common.no_shared_pcs: There are no shared computers to control.
common.all_offline: None of your computers is online.
common.feature_off: This command is turned off in the settings of {{pc}}.
common.pc_not_understood: I didn't get which computer. Cancelling.
common.not_understood: I didn't get which one. Cancelling.
common.offer_wake: The computer {{pc}} is off. Turn it on?
common.kept_off: OK, I won't turn it on.
common.child_denied: Only an adult can do that.
common.guest_denied: Computers can't be controlled in guest mode.
common.unknown_denied: I don't recognize the voice, so I won't control the computer.
common.who_unknown: I don't know who is speaking, so I'm not doing anything.

errors.feature_disabled: This command is turned off in the settings of {{pc}}.
errors.launcher_missing: {{name}} needs a launcher that {{pc}} doesn't have.
errors.needs_elevation: It needs administrator rights. Confirm the request on the computer's screen.
errors.cancelled: The launch was cancelled on the computer.
errors.helper_unavailable: The client on {{pc}} can't do it. Restart Ghost Hands on the computer.
errors.invalid_args: The computer didn't understand the command.
errors.unknown_action: The client on {{pc}} doesn't know this command. Update it.
errors.parental_limit: Time on {{pc}} is over for today.
errors.internal: I couldn't run the command on {{pc}}.

launch_app.label: Start an app or a game on the computer
launch_app.not_found: I couldn't find {{name}} on your computers.
launch_app.deferred: Turning on {{pc}}. I'll start {{names, list}} when it boots.
launch_app.deferred_failed: I couldn't start {{names, list}}: {{pc}} never came online

close_app.label: Close an app or a game on the computer
close_app.not_found: I couldn't find {{name}} among running apps.
close_app.no_game: I don't see any running games.
close_app.shell_active: The desktop or File Explorer is in front on {{pc}}, I don't close those.
close_app.which: Which one should I close: {{names, list(type: disjunction)}}?
close_app.background: {{name}} runs in the background without a window. Force it to close?

pc_power.label: Shut down, restart, put to sleep or lock the computer
pc_power.confirm_shutdown_open: Shut down {{pc}}? {{apps, list}} is still running.
pc_power.display_off_many: Turning off the monitors of {{pcs, list}}.
pc_power.display_off_later: The monitor of {{pc}} will turn off {{when}}.
pc_power.display_off_later_many: The monitors of {{pcs, list}} will turn off {{when}}.

pc_wake.label: Turn on the computer over the network
pc_wake.error: I couldn't turn on the computer.
pc_wake.failed: I couldn't send the wake signal to {{pc}}.
pc_wake.sent: Turning on {{pc}}. It will be online in about a minute.
pc_wake.sent_wifi: Sending the wake signal to {{pc}}. Over Wi-Fi it doesn't always work.

pc_media.label: Music and video on the computer: pause, resume, next track

pc_parental.label: Parental control on a computer: lift or bring back the limits
pc_parental.granted: The limits on {{pc}} are lifted until {{until}}.
pc_parental.granted_day: The limits on {{pc}} are lifted for the rest of the day.
pc_parental.not_owner: Only the owner of {{pc}} can do that.
pc_parental.none: No computer is under parental control.

pc_status.label: Which computers are online and what runs on them
pc_status.running_hidden: {{pc}} doesn't share its list of running apps.
pc_status.none_online: No computer is online right now.

pc_control.label: Computer control: start and close apps and games, shutdown, volume, music and web search
pc_control.error: I couldn't run the command on the computer.
pc_control.unknown: There is no such command for the computer.

prompts.app_pick: The person said: "{{phrase}}". Which app from the list do they mean?
prompts.app_pick_system: You pick an app or a game from the list by how a person named it by voice in Russian or English: a translation, an abbreviation, slang ("ведьмак" is The Witcher, "контра" is Counter-Strike). If nothing fits, choose none. Answer only with JSON.
